Fixtures for tests/loaders.test.js (each under 1 MB).

Missing fixtures now fail; they never skip a comparison. fetch-fixtures.js pins and SHA-256 checks PCL at
3aac7b68cc8f26428ba9c9192d990c0c21cc5a7d and PyVista data at 5a3de12d34c24aa5dd5e5db1cbc2defebc0d4da3.
PyVista's data repository LICENSE is Apache-2.0. Fetch hashes are source bytes before Git CRLF conversion.
The OFF parser comparisons use box.off and mctri.off from John Burkardt's standard Geomview data collection:
https://people.sc.fsu.edu/~jburkardt/data/off/off.html explicitly grants GNU LGPL for its code and data.
The upstream page does not state a version; the accompanying LGPL-3.0 and GPL-3.0 texts are supplied.
box.off is the cube example; mctri.off credits its MC-letter mesh to MC. Both are unchanged downloads.
The legacy decimated-knight.off is retained for held physics tests and the existing benchmark workload only;
its libigl/Cosmic Blobs attribution has no verified licence grant and it is not fetched or used by this loader comparison.

Margo-made, written by scripts/make-fixtures.js (procedural shapes, deterministic bytes, no third-party data):
  torus.ply, torus_be.ply, torus_le.ply, torus_colored.ply, gears.3mf, face_colors.3mf, corner_colors.3mf,
  rose.pcd, spiral.pcd, helix.xyz

Written by outside tools from data Margo's script made, no third-party content: sphere-lzma.vtp, sphere-lzma-appended.vtp and
sphere-ascii.vtp by VTK 9.7.2's vtkXMLPolyDataWriter (a vtkSphereSource), volume-bzip2.nrrd and volume-raw.nrrd by pynrrd 1.1.3.

Third-party, committed here (the tests never download them; scripts/fetch-fixtures.js refreshes them by hand):
Point Cloud Library test data, test/bunny.pcd (BSD-3-Clause, https://github.com/PointCloudLibrary/pcl,
  Copyright (c) 2009-2012 Willow Garage, Inc., Copyright (c) 2012- Open Perception, Inc.; licence text:
  https://github.com/PointCloudLibrary/pcl/blob/master/LICENSE.txt), a subsampled scan of the Stanford bunny
  (Stanford 3D Scanning Repository): bunny.pcd, the same bytes as packages/points/tests/fixtures/bunny.pcd
John Burkardt Geomview standard data (GNU LGPL, https://people.sc.fsu.edu/~jburkardt/data/off/off.html): box.off, mctri.off
Legacy held physics/workload data: decimated-knight.off, libigl tutorial data/Cosmic Blobs, licence unresolved
PyVista vtk-data (https://github.com/pyvista/vtk-data): fran_cut.vtk, polyEx.vtk

OpenVDB sphere.vdb (861,072 bytes), standard level-set sample, unchanged:
https://media.githubusercontent.com/media/AcademySoftwareFoundation/openvdb-website/3d8fd4d3f2d670464f4390e2775cfc87274233dc/download/models/sphere.vdb
SHA-256 bb884a9a38354e47191c4ece4a11d1e051594a910fde56501cfc51ff52b171ab
CC-BY-4.0, Academy Software Foundation/OpenVDB website contributors, under the repository's LICENSE.txt:
https://github.com/AcademySoftwareFoundation/openvdb-website/blob/3d8fd4d3f2d670464f4390e2775cfc87274233dc/LICENSE.txt
The test compares all 1,451 decoded leaf blocks' finiteness, the 270,638 active voxels and the active bounds
with the independently stored metadata. It also checks signed interior/exterior background values.
The OFF MC-letter sample has trailing per-face RGBA; OFF currently reads its geometry, not per-face colour.

empty-full.vdb and empty-half.vdb are original Margo-authored two-voxel grids, Apache-2.0, written through
OpenVDB 13.0 in Blender 5.3.0 Beta ecaf39c37b28 by make-vdb-empty.py (no OpenVDB implementation copied).
The same native writer saves both precisions; vdb-empty-oracle.json is what native OpenVDB reads back.
Full-precision empty streams retain a compressed empty block; the half-value stream omits that block.
These paired controls distinguish precision from file version. Reproduction command is in make-vdb-empty.py.

Carnegie Mellon University Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database (http://mocap.cs.cmu.edu/), "free for all uses",
redistribution of the data allowed. "The data used in this project was obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu. The database
was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217." Used by tests/acclaim.test.js, trimmed by hand to a few KB:
  cmu/35.asf: subject 35's skeleton, http://mocap.cs.cmu.edu/subjects/35/35.asf (source SHA-256
    2a8e2eda3c0d7d828566b2a9a8ab36b2b8b3864110574e8b73c8f069fded416c), comment lines dropped and white space collapsed.
  cmu/35_01-every-20th.amc: walk 35_01, http://mocap.cs.cmu.edu/subjects/35/35_01.amc (source SHA-256
    0743f4ea48e7e199cd56b2810b5ce81f8ede08d32ff79aa4e363c44cc4fe33aa), frames 1, 21, ..., 121 of the first second
    renumbered 1 to 7, values rounded to 3 decimals.
